faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ShotApp AI.

items.q: Do I need design skills to use ShotApp AI?
items.a: Not at all. ShotApp AI is built specifically to automate the design process. You provide the app screenshots and text, and our Engine handles layout, consistency, lighting, and typography.

items.q: Can I use my own fonts and brand colors?
items.a: Yes. On the Pro and Agency plans, you can upload your full Brand Kit, including custom TTF/OTF fonts and exact hex codes. The engine will lock these in across your entire screenshot set.

items.q: How does the AI ensure consistency?
items.a: Unlike generic image generators, ShotApp AI uses a deterministic layout and styling pipeline governed by the Consistency Engine. It applies a global style graph across all slides in a set simultaneously, rather than rendering them individually.

items.q: What format do I get the final screenshots in?
items.a: You receive a perfectly sized, high-resolution ZIP file containing PNGs optimized for immediate upload to App Store Connect and Google Play Console.

items.q: Can I regenerate just one slide?
items.a: Yes. Our surgical editing feature lets you regenerate a single slide without breaking the visual coherence of the entire batch.

items.q: How does the credit system work?
items.a: Each slide generation or regeneration costs 1 credit. Translating a slide costs 1 credit per language. Credits are replenished monthly based on your plan, and unused credits roll over for 30 days.

items.q: How many slides does a typical screenshot set have?
items.a: A standard App Store set contains 5–10 screenshots. ShotApp AI generates a complete, cohesive 5–10 slide set in a single session. The Free plan gives you a preview of the first slide; paid plans unlock the full set.
We support both Apple App Store (iOS/iPadOS) and Google Play Store (Android). Each platform has specific aspect ratio requirements, and our engine handles them automatically.
Yes. The Free plan includes 3 credits to try the full generation workflow. No credit card required to start.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains what data ShotApp AI collects, why we process it, and the choices you have. By using the service, you agree to this processing as described below.

data.title: 1. Data we collect
data.body: We collect account details, project metadata, uploaded assets, generated outputs, billing events, and technical logs needed to operate ShotApp AI.

usage.title: 2. How we use data
usage.body: We use your data to provide screenshot generation, account security, payment processing, fraud prevention, and support. We do not sell personal data.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.body: We process data to perform our contract with you, protect legitimate business interests (security and abuse prevention), and comply with legal obligations.

retention.title: 4. Data retention
retention.body: We retain data while your account is active, or as required for legal and financial compliance. You can request deletion from your account settings.

security.title: 5. Security measures
security.body: We use access controls, encryption in transit, signed asset URLs, and role-based database policies to reduce unauthorized access risks.

processors.title: 6. Third-party processors
processors.body: We rely on infrastructure and payment partners such as Supabase and Stripe. These processors handle data according to their own security and privacy terms.

transfers.title: 7. International transfers
transfers.body: Your data may be processed in countries other than your own. We use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers where required.

rights.title: 8. Your rights
rights.body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, or portability of your personal data.

children.title: 9. Children's privacy
children.body: ShotApp AI is not intended for children under 13 (or equivalent minimum age in your jurisdiction), and we do not knowingly collect their personal data.

changes.title: 10. Policy changes
changes.body: We may update this policy as the product or legal requirements evolve. We will post the latest version on this page.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.body: Privacy requests can be sent to

billing.body: Paid plans are billed on a recurring monthly basis. Credits are consumed per action as shown in-product. Abuse, chargebacks, or fraud may lead to suspension.
